disposition_reason: The selected primary is now the original Figure 2 method endpoint, not a biological effect-size target. Authentic Figure 2 support, final source baseline vector, real-data fitting/split route and a source-grounded full-panel superiority policy remain unresolved. Existing arithmetic accepts supplied likelihood operands and does not establish a fitted original-data baseline.

source_paper.title: Specialized structure of neural population codes in parietal cortex outputs

evidence.locator: Results: Vine copula models to analyze encoding in multivariate neural and behavioral data; Fig. 2b,c; Extended Data Fig. 1g
evidence.supports: Frame-by-frame neural response prediction is an ordered endpoint; FDE is displayed as a distribution. The paper reports ten mice and 59 sessions.

evidence.locator: Methods: NPvC models of single-neuron activity, Eq. 6 and following two paragraphs; calcium-imaging preprocessing
evidence.supports: Defines conditional inputs, OASIS deconvolution, fivefold fitting, five task epochs, eight trial types, minimum trial support and model-specific deviance normalization.
Author repository supplies NPvC, glmnet and simulation comparisons. Its README does not establish a complete real-data Figure 2 evaluation or historical fold ledger.
Names Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/NL1CAQ as the original data source; this does not authenticate the release-to-session mapping.

target.description: Recreate and improve the original Figure 2b,c held-out conditional prediction of deconvolved PPC activity using NPvC and GLM comparisons, retaining the complete source neuronwise FDE distribution and source-defined companion outputs across the original five epochs and eight trial types.

dataset.description: Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/NL1CAQ, recorded release 1.0 (2025-08-15). The inherited registration records 70 files: 64 session archives and six support files. This inventory is not the authenticated Figure 2 release-to-session/neuron eligibility manifest; pin that mapping before admission. No substitute dataset.

cohort.description: Retain the original Figure 2 eligible projection-defined and unlabeled PPC neuron population from the reported ten mice and 59 sessions; the paper reports 2860 analyzed cells but panel-specific inclusion is not authenticated. Preserve source behavioral performance >70% and at least five trials of every one of eight trial types, all eligible epochs, exclusions and animal/session/neuron/projection joins. Do not treat archive count as eligible session count.

split.description: Use the original fivefold cross-validation and bandwidth-fitting protocol. The precise frame/time-point versus whole-trial assignment unit remains unresolved. Recover that protocol, then authenticate historical memberships or a documented source-conformant stochastic rerun with recorded seeds, shared candidate-author folds and predeclared justified publication calibration. Do not replace it with whole-mouse holdout.

inputs.description: Time; virtual heading; lateral/forward running velocities and accelerations; trial type defined by sample cue, test cue and correct/incorrect outcome, in all five original event epochs. These are original conditional inputs, including outcome information; this is not a causal forecasting or native raw-signal claim.

preprocessing.description: Retain source OASIS AR1 cell-specific deconvolution, source activity scales and -0.5 to +2 second sample/delay/test/turn/reward epochs. Release-field mapping, alignment, full real-data fit caller and observed-density interpolation remain unresolved. No rounding deconvolved activity, clipping FDE or silently changing transforms.

metric.description: Eq. 6 neuronwise held-out FDE=(L_model-L_null)/(L_sat-L_null), summing log-likelihood differences over held-out observations before the ratio. Preserve distinct original model-specific normalizers: NPvC conditional peak over the source 200-point activity grid and marginal null; GLM Poisson saturated mean equal to observed activity and fitted null mean, including lgamma(y+1) for noninteger deconvolved activity. Preserve source grid coordinates spaced (max-min)/199 and integration step (max-min)/200. Preserve signed/out-of-range FDE and explicit undefined zero-denominator states with full row support. No shared replacement denominator.

aggregation.description: Original Figure 2 neuronwise FDE cumulative distributions and their complete per-neuron/per-epoch source records. Authentic panel membership, native summary/contrast and source-reference mapping remain unresolved. Do not collapse to a newly selected mean, a favorable projection subgroup, neuron count or larger denominator gain.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Figure 2 neuronwise held-out FDE performance panel with source-specific NPvC and GLM normalizers; no replacement scalar aggregate

published_baseline.description: Recover the complete source Figure 2 NPvC and GLM FDE vectors, matched support and reference convention. The publication shows distributions; no exact numeric vector or scalar baseline is currently authenticated. Null/saturated likelihoods are mandatory fidelity operands, not superiority targets.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No full authentic real-data Figure 2 author fit/reference run is established. Retain original NPvC and GLM; calibrate any recorded source-conformant stochastic rerun against the publication with a justified predeclared tolerance. The supplied-operand FDE arithmetic and signed-motif component do not establish this run.

minimum_effect.rationale: Unresolved until source reference variability and the complete original performance panel are authenticated. Freeze a scientifically justified effect/uncertainty policy before candidates; no universal numeric margin or new scalar is invented.

uncertainty.method: Recover the original model-comparison and resampling design, then predeclare a paired analysis respecting neurons nested within sessions and mice.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological replication; original neuronwise corpus metric retained separately.
uncertainty.rationale: Triplets, cells, folds and time points cannot become independent mice. Exact animal/session mapping is needed before selecting an uncertainty rule.

paper_win_requires: Resolve original dataset/cohort/split/inputs/preprocessing and recover the complete NPvC and GLM performance panels, not only an easier baseline or selected neurons.

Use the same original source protocol and full support for candidate and author. Preserve original model-specific Eq. 6 conventions for reproduction. Candidate model admissibility and its denominator must be independently justified from the source task before evaluation; they are currently unresolved. An evaluator-owned source-grounded policy must prevent candidate-chosen density scaling/grid changes while not silently imposing a new universal normalizer.

Predeclare a scientifically justified complete-panel comparison and uncertainty/effect policy against the strongest relevant source author method and both published and reproduced references. Beating GLM alone does not surpass the paper NPvC result; a candidate-selected denominator or subgroup cannot establish a win.
Retain null, saturated, likelihood and source-control operands as fidelity/diagnostic outputs, never maximize them. No significance, motif enrichment or biological interaction-information reward.
Implement pending panel-admission support without inventing a scalar alias. Source-paper superiority remains separate from any independently researched current-SOTA claim.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was verified; source-paper results and any future author rerun remain separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: Once admitted, develop candidate conditional neural predictors on declared original-protocol training/internal validation information. Source recovery and author calibration precede protected final comparison.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate code, hyperparameters, transformations, permitted observations, source-conformant folds/seeds, source density and normalization admissibility, complete support and declared effect/uncertainty policies before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the complete original Figure 2 source performance panel on matched candidate-author held-out observations; independently compute the original method-specific likelihoods and FDE, retaining every eligible row and undefined-score state. No selected-subgroup completion.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep publication NPvC/GLM vectors and independently reproduced author vectors distinct. A source-grounded fixed panel policy must select the strongest relevant author comparison without candidate cherry-picking. Null/saturated/control outputs are fidelity requirements, not optimization objectives.

blocking_issues: Authenticate original release-to-animal/session/neuron/epoch eligibility and all required observations; the 70-file metadata inventory is not complete source support.
Recover the original fivefold split unit/protocol, real-data fit construction, interpolation and executable preprocessing/fit route; preserve original scales and conditional information.
Recover full publication/reference NPvC and GLM FDE vectors, model-specific likelihood/normalization operands and publication-equivalent author calibration.

Resolve the source-grounded candidate density/normalization admissibility and full-panel superiority rule before admission. Neither shared-denominator substitution nor density scaling is an accepted policy.
Freeze matching access conditions, meaningful effect, dependence-aware uncertainty, justified reproduction tolerance and measured episode budgets.

Panel improvement admission/interface is pending. Preserve the full source performance vector and mandatory controls; do not invent a scalar mean, favorable subgroup, win count or significance objective. No new AI/model study is required to finish source construction; an AI outcome requires a separate subsequent qualifying execution.

legacy.notes: The previous biological primary task is preserved at historical/primary-biological-20261117-v1/task.json; its unchanged root reproduction/improvement/outcomes metadata keep their historical meanings. implementations/signed-motifs remains calibration for supplied graphs. implementations/fde-equations-v1 computes supplied-operand arithmetic and does not establish Figure 2 source fitting or authentic readiness.
